scope: Public source, implemented functions, design boundaries and public documentation only.

architecture.backend: C++20 / Linux / epoll / Reactor / TCP / TIMX
architecture.gateway: Two Gateway instances and gRPC business services
architecture.deployment: Docker Compose with optional desktop file/history ingress

features: Password login, heartbeat, session replacement and per-account window lock
Friend requests, acceptance, rejection and relationship-based private chat authorization
Private chat, durable acknowledgment, receiver acknowledgment, retry and offline recovery
Conversation list, unread projection, private read state and paginated history
Group creation, membership, invitation, roles, muting, transfer and dissolution
Group history authorization using current membership and original delivery scope
Chunked file upload, resume, cancel, retry, SHA-256 verification and authorized download
Desktop multi-account workflows with isolated transfer tasks
Ollama streaming, model detection, cancellation and optional loaded conversation context
boundaries: Public source distribution does not include runtime databases, private configuration or model weights
Desktop Ollama and backend MCP are separate integration paths
Benchmark claims must retain the workload, version and acceptance boundaries in public reports
Self-service registration, complete desktop TLS and full 20k-50k capacity acceptance remain future work
privacy: Raw internal retrospective and audit material is retained locally and is excluded from this public summary.
